topics.title: JVM Architecture, Class Structure & Primitive Types
topics.objective: Understand bytecode execution, class declarations, main method, and type casting.
topics.example: public class App { public static void main(String[] args) { System.out.println("Java"); } }
topics.exercise: Write a command line application that validates user input and computes tax calculations.

topics.title: Encapsulation, Inheritance & Polymorphic Interfaces
topics.objective: Design reusable class hierarchies using abstract classes, interfaces, and override annotations.
topics.exercise: Model a company payroll system with Employee base class and Salaried/Hourly implementations.

topics.title: Java Collections Framework & Generics
topics.objective: Master ArrayList, HashMap, HashSet, and iterator traversal patterns.
topics.example: Map<String, Integer> freq = new HashMap<>(); freq.put("key", 1);
topics.exercise: Implement an in-memory phonebook directory with duplicate name detection.

topics.title: Exception Handling & Resource Management (try-with-resources)
topics.objective: Handle checked and unchecked exceptions gracefully and auto-close AutoCloseable resources.
topics.exercise: Build a resilient file parser that catches IO and parsing exceptions with informative error logging.

topics.title: Lambda Expressions & Stream API
topics.objective: Write functional data transformations using map, filter, reduce, and collectors.
topics.exercise: Transform and aggregate a dataset of order transactions into regional sales totals.
